summary: Receives TUIO network packets and parses TUIO 1.1 or 2.0 OSC bundle data into table columns for multitouch and tangible-interface workflows.

key_params.name: protocol
key_params.note: UDP messaging, multicast UDP, or reliable UDT messaging

key_params.name: address
key_params.note: Multicast address when using multicast protocol

key_params.name: shared
key_params.note: Share the network connection with compatible DATs

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Enable receiving; data sent while inactive is lost

key_params.name: fromop
key_params.note: Operator path used when Execute from is set to Specified Operator

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when extension mode uses a custom extension

common_gotchas: TUIO packets are OSC bundles; use OSC In DAT when raw OSC inspection is more useful than parsed TUIO rows.
Protocol and port must match the sending TUIO application or tracker.
The output table represents parsed object/cursor state, so session IDs and lifetimes matter downstream.
Callbacks execute once events are received; choose Execute from carefully when callback code uses relative paths.
Multicast setups need matching multicast address and local network/firewall permissions.
key_concepts: TUIO In DAT receives network TUIO messages and parses them into table columns.
TUIO packets are OSC bundles, so OSC In DAT can show a more raw view of the same traffic.
The operator supports TUIO 1.1 and 2.0 workflows through UDP, multicast, or reliable messaging protocols.
Callbacks can run for TUIO events from the configured execution context.
